Community-hub meaning: Origin of thermal, chemical, particulate, acoustic, or airflow loading
Example: Cooking activity, cleaning product use, vehicle-adjacent outdoor air, direct sun on entrance paving
Required evidence: Source category, time interval, magnitude or proxy, evidence method
Boundary uncertainty: Source duration, strength, intermittency, sensor placement

Community-hub meaning: Movement of air, heat, particles, VOCs, moisture, or noise
Example: Doorway infiltration, cross-ventilation path, fan-driven air path, pedestrian-induced door cycling
Required evidence: Direction, estimated flow/velocity, opening state, upstream/downstream zones
Boundary uncertainty: Mixing, wind shifts, flow estimation, sensor lag

Example: Indoor thermal mass, upholstered materials retaining VOCs, vegetation/shade zone, filter media
Required evidence: Retention mechanism, capacity/range, inspection or refresh interval
Boundary uncertainty: Desorption, thermal release, breakthrough, delayed effects

Community-hub meaning: Change of state, concentration, or perceived condition
Example: Filtration, dilution, solar heating, evaporative cooling, humidity buffering
Required evidence: Mechanism, expected effect, time constant, maintenance state
Boundary uncertainty: Filter performance drift, nonuniform mixing, weather change

Community-hub meaning: Protected endpoint or occupant-facing environmental zone
Example: Respiratory-sensitivity refuge zone, entrance waiting zone, child activity space, staff desk
Required evidence: Protection objective, accessibility needs, exposure duration, review authority
Boundary uncertainty: Occupancy not measured at individual level; use zone-level risk only

Community-hub meaning: Material or condition left after intervention
Example: Captured filter particles, VOC-loaded carbon, concentrated outdoor pollutant infiltrating during purge, retained heat after closure
Required evidence: Treatment method, residual form, maintenance and handling route
Boundary uncertainty: Residual persistence, disposal evidence, rebound after treatment
